summary: Autosave hook commits a worker's mid-session edits (93c2b8a on worker/14d64950c0bc), forcing a fixer to reset the branch pointer to produce the single commit its brief requires

resolution.reason: Intentional, judged three times now: reconcile's autosave commits a live worker's half-edited tree so that nothing a worker wrote is ever lost when a checkout is released. Reviewers judge the branch tip against main as one change, never commit by commit, so an autosave commit on the branch costs nothing. A fixer that wants one commit may reset the pointer as this one did; a brief that asks for one commit means one commit of the fixer's own on top of whatever the hook left.
